PLAN "12-Week Integrated Low-Impact Strength, Cardio, Recovery & Mobility for Ski Return"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary_strength:
    name "Increase strength and prepare for skiing with low-impact, knee-safe training"
  GOAL maintain_weight:
    name "Maintain current body weight with balanced macronutrients"
  GOAL recovery_mobility:
    name "Improve recovery, mobility, and knee resilience"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 30m "Cardio - Intervals":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 6x2..3m rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 75m "Upper - Strength (volume)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 5x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Cardio - Tempo":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 1x25m rpe 7
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 75m "Lower - Hypertrophy (knee-friendly)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 5x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Saturday training 30m "Recovery & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_circles 2x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          leg_swings 2x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          ankle_circles 2x10 rpe 5 rest 20 seconds
          cat_cow 3x8 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          pigeon_pose 2x60s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Lower - Strength (progressive)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 4x8 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 30m "Recovery & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_circles 2x12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          leg_swings 2x12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x60s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          figure_four_stretch 2x60s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 75m "Upper - Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 5x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Cardio - Fartlek":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 10x1m rpe 8 rest 1m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 80m "Lower - Control (volume)":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 5x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 5x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Saturday training 30m "Mobility Flow":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:

          spinal_twist 2x60s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds

          calf_stretch 2x60s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 5m
    WEEK 3:

    WEEK 4:
